80 method FindWinner<Candidate(==)>(a: seq<Candidate>, ghost K: Candidate) returns (k: Candidate)
81   requires HasMajority(a, 0, |a|, K) // K has a (strict) majority of the votes
82   ensures k == K  // find K

92     if a[n] == k {
93       n, c := n + 1, c + 1;
94     } else if 2 * c > n + 1 - s {
95       n := n + 1;
96     } else {
97       n := n + 1;
98       // We have 2*Count(a, s, n, k) == n-s, and thus the following lemma

106     }
107   }

118 method DetermineElection<Candidate(==,0,!new)>(a: seq<Candidate>) returns (result: Result<Candidate>)
